_comment: LoopStar GENERATIVE material pack (LP.6 / Phase MG). Genre-authentic DNA for the on-device 'Make it new' generator (LoopStarMaterialEngine). The Swift binary is a SKELETON (RULE #1): it ships a clamped tempo-heuristic fallback and reads THIS file at runtime for the real genre feel. Zero-rebuild to tune. Schema owner: LoopStarGenrePack.swift.
name: House
blurb: Classic / deep house: a four-on-the-floor pulse, hissing offbeat open hats, and pumping rootless Rhodes stabs over a warm synth-bass bounce.

flavors.label: Deep House
flavors.blurb: Two dorian chords breathing over a warm bass - Rhodes ninths, nothing in a hurry.

flavors.label: Jack Track
flavors.blurb: Chicago jack: one minor chord for the whole loop, stabbed hard and dead on the grid.

flavors.label: Gospel Garage
flavors.blurb: Jersey garage - the major ii-V turnaround, fat ninths, swung and played by hand.

flavors.label: Piano Anthem
flavors.blurb: Four bright minor changes, one per bar, hammered like a 90s piano house drop.

flavors.label: French Touch
flavors.blurb: Filtered disco loop - long sustained chords swimming under the filter instead of stabbing.

arranger.llmStyleBrief: House harmony sits still. Two-chord dorian vamps and static i9 loops are more common than any cadence. Write rootless minor sevenths and ninths over a root-driven bass, moving by step or to bVI and bVII. In major, use the gospel ii-V turnaround. Avoid V-i resolutions. Keep loops 2 or 4 bars.
